criteria.text: With mcpAllowlist = { servers: [], tools: ['srvA_tool1'] }: resolveTools MCP output includes srvA_tool1, excludes srvA_tool2 and srvB_tool1.
criteria.test_id: mcp-scope-02-c1: explicit tool key allowlist > returns only srvA_tool1 when tools=['srvA_tool1'] and servers=[]

criteria.text: With mcpAllowlist = { servers: ['srvB'], tools: [] }: output includes all srvB_* tools, excludes all srvA_*.
criteria.test_id: mcp-scope-02-c2: server-level allowlist passes all server tools > returns all srvB_* tools when servers=['srvB'] and tools=[]

criteria.text: With mcpAllowlist = { servers: [], tools: [] } (empty both): zero MCP tools in output.
criteria.test_id: mcp-scope-02-c3: empty allowlist returns no tools > returns empty array when both servers and tools are empty

criteria.text: With mcpAllowlist = undefined: output identical to upstream (all MCP tools present — no behavior change).
criteria.test_id: mcp-scope-02-c4: undefined allowlist returns all tools (back-compat) > returns all tool keys when allowlist is undefined

criteria.text: An id in tools that no server exposes is silently absent (no throw).
criteria.test_id: mcp-scope-02-c5: unknown key in tools list is silently absent > does not throw when tools contains a key that no server exposes

helper.name: filterMcpToolsByAllowlist
helper.signature: filterMcpToolsByAllowlist(toolKeys: string[], keyToServer: Record<string, string>, mcpAllowlist: { servers: string[]; tools: string[] } | undefined): string[]
helper.notes: Pure function. toolKeys = Object.keys(mcp.tools()). keyToServer = index built from MCP.tools() clientName metadata (NOT string-split on '_'). resolveTools calls this and skips any key not in the returned set.
